tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity to Figma.

tools.name: get-file
tools.description: Get the structure of a Figma file (pages, frames, top-level components). Returns curated { name, lastModified, version, thumbnailUrl, document, componentCount, styleCount }. Params: fileKey, depth (1-10, def 2), geometry?, branchData?, fields?, includeRaw.

annotations.summary: Open a file's pages and frames

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

depth.description: How deep to traverse the document tree. Min 1, max 10, default 2.

geometry.description: Set to 'paths' to include vector path data (heavier payload).

branchData.description: Include branch metadata when the file is part of a branched workflow.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: get-node
tools.description: Get a single node from a Figma file as a curated tree. Returns the node directly (not wrapped). Use this to drill into a frame/component beyond the depth returned by get-file. Params: fileKey, nodeId (accepts "1-2" or "1:2"), depth (1-10, def 3), fields?, includeRaw.

annotations.summary: Inspect a single frame or component

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

nodeId.description: Node ID. Accepts the URL format "1-2" or REST format "1:2".

depth.description: How deep to traverse children. Min 1, max 10, default 3.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream node. Default false.

tools.name: get-file-styles
tools.description: List styles defined in a Figma file. Returns { styles: [{id, key, name, type, description}], count }. type ∈ FILL/TEXT/EFFECT/GRID. Params: fileKey, fields?, includeRaw.

annotations.summary: List a file's color and text styles

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: get-file-variables
tools.description: Get design tokens (variables) from a Figma file, grouped by collection. Returns { collections: [{id, name, modes, variables, defaultModeId}] }. Each variable has { id, name, type, values: { [modeId]: value } }. type ∈ COLOR/FLOAT/STRING/BOOLEAN. Params: fileKey, fields?, includeRaw.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: get-components
tools.description: List components defined in a Figma file. Returns { components: [{id, key, name, description, componentSetId?}], count }. Params: fileKey, fields?, includeRaw.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: get-component-sets
tools.description: List component sets (variant groups) defined in a Figma file. Returns { componentSets: [{id, key, name, description}], count }. Params: fileKey, fields?, includeRaw.

annotations.summary: List variant groups in a file

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: export-images
tools.description: Export Figma nodes as images. Returns { images: [{nodeId, url, format, scale}] }. URLs are pre-signed S3 links and expire in ~30 minutes. Formats: png|jpg|svg|pdf. Scale 0.01-4 (default 1). Params: fileKey, nodeIds, format?, scale?, fields?, includeRaw.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs to export. Accepts "1-2" or "1:2".

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: get-comments
tools.description: List comments on a Figma file. Returns { comments: [{id, message, createdAt, user, resolved, parentId?, clientMeta?}], count }. parentId !== undefined indicates a reply. Params: fileKey, fields?, includeRaw.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: create-comment
tools.description: Create a new comment on a Figma file, or reply to an existing one. Returns the created comment { id, message, createdAt, user, resolved, parentId? }. To reply, set parentCommentId. To anchor on a canvas position, set clientMeta { x, y } or { node_id }. Params: fileKey, message, parentCommentId?, clientMeta?, fields?, includeRaw.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

message.description: Comment body. Markdown not rendered by Figma — keep plain text or use mentions like @user.

parentCommentId.description: When provided, the new comment is a reply to this comment ID.

clientMeta.description: Optional canvas anchor. Either { x, y } for a free position or { node_id } to attach to a node.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: delete-comment
tools.description: Delete a comment from a Figma file. Returns { ok: true, fileKey, commentId } on success. Not reversible — confirm with the user before invoking. Params: fileKey, commentId.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

commentId.description: ID of the comment to delete.

tools.name: list-file-versions
tools.description: List the version history of a Figma file. Returns { versions: [{id, createdAt, label, description, user, thumbnailUrl?}], count, nextPage? }. Use to audit changes, compare versions, or find when a design broke. Params: fileKey, pageSize (1-50, def 30), before? (cursor from previous nextPage), fields?, includeRaw.

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

pageSize.description: Versions per page. Min 1, max 50, default 30.

before.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response.nextPage.

includeRaw.description: Return raw upstream payload. Default false.

tools.name: extract-colors
tools.description: Extract solid colors from a file or node, formatted for CSS variables, Tailwind config, or JSON. Returns { count, output: string, format }. Params: fileKey, nodeId? (scope to one node), format? (default css).

annotations.summary: Extract colors as CSS or Tailwind

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.

nodeId.description: Optional: scope extraction to a single node.

tools.name: extract-typography
tools.description: Extract typography styles (font family, size, weight, line height, letter spacing) used in TEXT nodes of a Figma file. Returns { count, output: string, format }. Params: fileKey, format? (default css).

annotations.summary: Extract fonts as CSS or Tailwind

fileKey.description: The file key from a Figma URL.
